knowledge.plain_language_summary: A double-sided internally lit fabricated aluminum cabinet monument with push-thru acrylic logo and ID panels, saddle-mounted on twin steel pipes in a cast-in-place footing. Carries a primary wordmark, a directional legend, and an address bar.
knowledge.rationale: Push-thru acrylic with welded studs and concealed reveal bars gives a clean seam-free lit face; twin-pipe saddle mount carries a wide cabinet and keeps service access (removable top + end panel).

structure.construction: 2x2x3/16in aluminum angle frame + .090in aluminum skin, removable top panel for service, painted brand blue, internal white LEDs, saddle-mounted to two 6in dia Sch40 steel pipes

3/4in clear acrylic with milled mounting shoulders (1/2in visible lip), 2nd surface 3M white light-diffuser film, 1st surface 3M translucent blue + opaque black, adhered to back of aluminum faces with welded studs
2x2x1/8in aluminum tube inner frame, 1/8in aluminum faces, push-thru acrylic, on 2x3x1/8in outer angle frame, painted white
.090in skin end panels (inward one removable for power-supply access) + 1x2in aluminum reveal bars hiding face seams, painted brand gray
1.5x1.5in steel angle saddles, field-welded to 6in dia Sch40 pipes, 3/8x1in through-bolts; cast-in-place concrete footing per engineer

rules_observations: Directional legend and address bar subordinate to the primary wordmark; one clear primary read.
craft_observations: Welded-stud push-thru with concealed reveal bars yields a seam-free lit face.
Dedicated brand-color paint codes plus removable top and end panel show production discipline.

open_items: Footing pending structural engineering; one 3M blue film code marked verify
